title: Beef Farming
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Facts (to confirm): beef breeds Boran and Zebu; beef areas include Laikipia, Kajiado, Narok and the Athi plains; Ankole in Uganda; Shinyanga in Tanzania. Kenya Meat Commission at Athi River.

skills.key_step: The child explains the factors that favour beef farming (grassland, water, suitable breeds, disease control, markets).

floor.question: Name one natural resource on a farm.

steps: Decide if beef farming will do well.

board.do: Draw a ranch with grass, a water pan and cattle.

board.say: Why does the ranch need this?

listen_for: A small crop farm in a wet highland
misconceptions.ask: Which area suits beef ranching best?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what cattle eat and how much land they need.

misconceptions.ask: Why are vets important for beef farmers?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what foot-and-mouth does to a herd.

misconceptions.ask: Which breed is kept mainly for beef in Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Compare photos of a Friesian (milk) and a Boran (beef).

misconceptions.ask: Why does a beef farmer need roads?
misconceptions.repair: Trace cattle from a ranch to the market and the meat factory.

checks.question: Give two factors that favour beef farming.
checks.answer: any two of: large grassland, water, warm climate, suitable breeds, disease control, market, roads

skills.key_step: The child locates the main beef farming areas of Eastern Africa.

floor.question: Why does beef farming need large grassland?

misconceptions.ask: Which area is known for beef ranching in Kenya?
misconceptions.repair: Ask which areas are dry grassland.

misconceptions.ask: What does Somalia export from its dry lands?
misconceptions.repair: Say animals feed on thorny bush and walk long distances to the port.

misconceptions.ask: Is beef farming done on the dry plains of Kajiado?
misconceptions.repair: Shade beef areas and dairy areas on the map in two colours.

misconceptions.ask: In which country is the Ankole cattle area?
misconceptions.repair: Put Ankole on the map in south-western Uganda.

checks.question: Name a beef farming area in Kenya.
checks.answer: any of: Laikipia, Kajiado, Narok, the Athi plains

checks.question: Is the Ankole cattle area in Kenya or Uganda?

skills.key_step: The child says how beef farming helps the economy.

floor.question: Give one way farming helps a county.
floor.answer: any such as jobs or income

representations: a chain from ranch to shop

board.do: Draw a cow with arrows to meat, hide and manure.
Write a gain on each arrow.

misconceptions.ask: What is made from the hides and skins of cattle?
misconceptions.repair: List a product from each part of the animal.

listen_for: Nobody, it is just for food
misconceptions.ask: Who earns a living from the beef industry?
misconceptions.repair: Name every person from ranch to shop.

misconceptions.ask: What are cattle hides used for?
misconceptions.repair: Show a leather shoe and trace it back to a hide.

listen_for: No, it is all eaten at home
misconceptions.ask: Do Eastern African countries sell beef and live animals abroad?
misconceptions.repair: Show live animals shipped from Berbera or Somalia ports (to confirm).

checks.question: Give two ways beef farming helps the economy.
checks.answer: any two of: food, jobs, income, foreign exchange, hides for leather, manure

skills.key_step: The child pairs the challenges of beef farming with their solutions.

floor.prerequisite: Says how beef farming helps the economy.
floor.question: Give one product from beef cattle.

steps: Pick the solution that removes the cause.

board.say: What helps cattle in a drought?

board.do: Wait for water pans or hay.

misconceptions.ask: What helps cattle during a long drought?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what the cattle lack: water and food, or cure for disease?
Pair each problem with the cause: theft needs security, ticks need dips.

misconceptions.ask: Beef prices are low. What helps farmers?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens to price when everyone brings more cattle to market.
